root_cause: The v2 report called coverage_loss zero while showing 79.296% OOF coverage of all eligible 2023 rows. The excluded 9,053 earliest rows were valid initial training-only observations, not missing validation predictions, but the report did not make that denominator distinction explicit.
affected_scope: v2 2023-only report wording and coverage gate interpretation. Its predeclared OOF probabilities and metrics remain immutable evidence, but cannot support a candidate survivor claim.
safe_remediation: v3 makes the validation-window universe explicit, records initial_training_only_rows separately, and fails closed if any expected validation row lacks an OOF prediction. It reruns the identical locked chronology and comparators under a new hash-bound protocol.
v2_market_gate_result: all Hits, HR, and Total Bases development gates failed independently
